# GitHub automation

Read [CI.md](../docs/CI.md) before changing runner setup, workflow triggers, permissions, check names, or diagnostics. Issue #15 selects this Mac's repository-specific foreground self-hosted runner because GitHub currently charges nothing for self-hosted execution. No hosted fallback, unattended service, scheduler, cache/artifact upload, or paid activation is approved.

Verification checks out the exact same-repository PR head, requires current base ancestry, and reports `Sidequest / verification`. Keep actions pinned to reviewed immutable SHAs and verification permissions at `contents: read`. Fork code cannot run on this Mac; do not introduce `pull_request_target` or execute unreviewed external actions.

Cancel obsolete PR verification only. The main-only [release workflow](../docs/RELEASES.md) has only a manual trigger under #112; merging a reviewed PR starts no main job. Only explicit owner authorization to publish permits workflow_dispatch on main, which runs verification first and reaches the publisher on the same foreground runner; the tracked readiness flag may reach main only after functional integration evidence, fresh review, and successful exact-head CI. Do not dispatch a manual run to replace the removed automatic main check. Main pushes never publish even afterward. Only publishing receives `contents: write` plus read permissions needed to verify run/check identity. Unique label `sidequest-mac-foreground`, API runner-ID checks, and local manifest validation prevent a different-host handoff; no upload fallback is approved.

Issue #31 established draft-first complete assets and immutable historical full-SHA previews; its release-history proof is complete. Issue #85 implements the user’s accepted `YYYY.MM.build` tag/display format from the exact live run’s UTC creation date and workflow run number. Preserve old tags and original bytes; never renumber collisions, overwrite assets/tags, or publish failed/incomplete builds. The verification manifest retains run number and publishing validates it against live metadata. Follow [release guidance](../docs/RELEASES.md) before publication, retries, or cost changes.

Issue #92 implements the user’s October 4 MVP release hold. Reenable the temporarily disabled workflow only after the reviewed hold configuration lands. Integration #9 may enable the tracked publication flag in its fully verified readiness PR; closing tickets alone does not enable it. The first MVP release was explicitly dispatched after historical readiness/main verification; later dispatches require explicit owner publication authorization under #112. Do not dispatch or rerun old push publishers while held; no environment bypass, scheduling, or automatic publication restoration is authorized. The separately authorized cleanup removes only older preview release objects/assets while preserving Git tags/source history and the retained latest preview. Follow [RELEASES.md](../docs/RELEASES.md).

Issue #90 uses the approved pre-design all-unit/three-UI smoke gate on one simulator and proven same-gate main test inheritance under [TESTING.md](../docs/TESTING.md), superseding the earlier serial duplicate-suite execution. Manual release provenance retains minimal read-only Actions/checks/PR/commit-status access and an explicit token; retain trusted same-repository code, pinned actions, exact-head PR review and manual publication.

Issue #112 supersedes automatic main verification: routine execution is same-repository PR-only, with exact-head CI and independent review before merge. Both release jobs require manual main dispatch; automatic events and feature/tag dispatches cannot start them. Keep manual provenance permissions and historical metadata/retry rules. Verify the merged commit and absence of an automatic main run through read-only metadata, without dispatching another check.
